items.message: `divergence()` always returns `read=self.ref` when both refs exist, even if the read actually came from the remote-tracking ref.
`pull()` silently returns success when `fetch` exits non-zero but the remote-tracking ref already exists from a prior fetch.
Tamper-detection `verify()` was changed to pass `head` instead of `self.ref` to `git log`; this is a behaviour change not mentioned in the PR description.
`_ledger_line` uses `getattr` to duck-type `divergence`, making it silently degrade when a real `GitLedger` is passed but `divergence` has a different signature in future.
